name: Seewoosagur Ramgoolam
role: Prime Minister of Mauritius from 1968 to 1982
contribution: A Mauritian physician and statesman who led Mauritius to independence from the United Kingdom.
legacy: His governments built a welfare state, introduced free secondary education and promoted the export processing zones that began the diversification of the sugar economy.

checks.lead: Sir Seewoosagur Ramgoolam  (18 September 1900 – 15 December 1985), often known as SSR or Chacha ("uncle"), was a Mauritian physician and statesman who led Mauritius to independence from the United Kingdom. He was the colony's chief minister from 1961 and premier from 1964, the first prime minister of independent Mauritius from 1968 to 1982, and governor-general from 1983 until his death. He is widely known in Mauritius as the "Father of the Nation".
